verdict.rationale: Docusign has a documented REST API and SDKs for creating/sending envelopes (docusign-docs-21, docusign-gh-1, docusign-docs-40) plus an official MCP server/connector for Claude that can retrieve agreement context and trigger IAM workflow actions (docusign-docs-11, docusign-docs-12, docusign-docs-39, docusign-probe-3), and AI-assisted drafting/redlining tools (CLM, AI-Assisted Review) that could generate NDA language. However, no single documented example ties these together into an agent autonomously drafting an NDA and routing it end-to-end for signature, and community reports flag real friction/edge-case bugs in embedded API signing flows (docusign-comm-1, docusign-comm-3) alongside positive integration reports (docusign-comm-4, docusign-comm-5). Missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end agent workflow doc/demo combining drafting+signature routing via API/MCP, and independent confirmation that the MCP server exposes document-creation (not just querying/triggering) actions.
